subject: Add epoch information to failover auth denied logs (#816)
reason: The change only edits the text of three serverLog warning messages in clusterSendFailoverAuthIfNeeded, appending the requested epoch to the 'Failover auth denied' logs. No control flow, vote logic, cluster bus message, reply, or persisted state changes, so there is no behaviour a scenario's oracles or a compared sequence could distinguish between the two builds.
